Beneath a light sculptural canopy, she adjusts the ribbon near one shoulder with one hand while the other rests naturally at her waist, keeping both elbows close. Slim white walkways and distant floating-looking architectural terraces are supported by subtle structural columns, creating believable near-future design. Use pale yellow, grape purple, dove gray, and clean white, with a gentle summer breeze and bright diffused architectural light. Use an eye-level camera and a calm three-quarter-length portrait. Place her centrally in the middle and lower frame, entirely inside a narrow phone-safe composition; keep hands close to her torso.
